assets.primaryRequest: Render the supplied reconnaissance-camp model as its industrial-era material evolution. Use gray-beige brick walls, muted gray-green painted sheet-metal on the continuous gable roof, lookout cap and attached supply awning, matte dark-steel tower posts and ladder, khaki supply packs, subdued wood doors and restrained aged-brass compass fittings. Keep the two plain narrow signal pennants, the shallow shuttered windows and every existing opening. Metal roofing has sparse seams and broad quiet panels.
assets.negativeRequest: No clay roof tiles, thatch, camouflage pattern, extra storey, sealed lookout supports or bright colored pennants.
